properties.level_of_theory: PM7 (Gaussian 16 RevC.01) primary; GFN2-xTB (xtb 6.5.0) cross-check; gas phase, charge 0
properties.geometry: planar six-membered ring, N-C 1.27-1.28 A, 30 real frequencies at PM7 -> verified minimum
properties.singlet_triplet_gap_kcal_mol: NOT DETERMINABLE within the allowed methods (xtb, pm7). The open-shell 1A2 singlet, which is the true lowest singlet, cannot be treated: the permitted PM7 input path rejects the UHF route keyword that an unrestricted Ms=0 SCF requires, and GFN2-xTB exposes only --uhf = multiplicity-1. The only computable singlet is the restricted closed-shell 1A1, which is NOT the lowest singlet: PM7 puts it +45.9 kcal/mol above 3A2 while GFN2-xTB puts its restricted singlet -1.7 kcal/mol below 3A2 - the two allowed levels disagree in sign, so neither value is declared as the singlet-triplet gap.
properties.state_ordering: phenylnitrene triplet 3A2 below the lowest singlet, the open-shell 1A2 n-pi biradical singlet (qualitative statement, standard for phenylnitrene; no number declared because 1A2 is not computable at the allowed level). The restricted closed-shell 1A1 singlet is a separate, higher-lying electronic state (PM7: +45.9 kcal/mol), not the lowest singlet.
properties.lowest_singlet_character: open-shell (1A2, n-pi) biradical singlet: two unpaired electrons of opposite spin, one in the in-plane N 2p lone-pair orbital and one in the ring pi system, essentially planar. Multireference by nature, hence outside what the restricted Ms=0 wavefunctions of PM7 and GFN2-xTB can describe; the character is therefore stated qualitatively and the species node is marked accessible: false.
properties.evidence_log_note: Level-specific energies of the closed-shell branch are recorded on node S1_1A1; they are semiempirical estimates for a state that is not the lowest singlet and must not be read as the singlet-triplet gap.
properties.evidence_log_original: pm7/t_optfreq.log (combined PM7 opt+freq, 0 imaginary frequencies, smiles-annotated) ; cross-check xtb_xcheck/ohess_t/t_start.out (GFN2-xTB, all real frequencies)

properties.state: phenylnitrene closed-shell (zwitterionic) singlet 1A1 - characterized branch, NOT the lowest singlet
properties.level_of_theory: PM7 (Gaussian 16) primary; GFN2-xTB cross-check; gas phase, charge 0
properties.relative_to_triplet_kcal_mol_PM7: +45.9 (semiempirical PM7 estimate for the closed-shell 1A1 branch only - NOT the singlet-triplet gap)
properties.relative_to_triplet_kcal_mol_GFN2xTB: -1.7 (restricted GFN2-xTB singlet - NOT the singlet-triplet gap; the sign differs from PM7)
properties.geometry: planar quinoid ring (N-C ~1.27 A, alternating C-C 1.37/1.41/1.45 A); the strictly planar PM7 structure is a saddle (-485.7 cm-1, pm7/s_cs_freq.log) and the true PM7 minimum is a marginally puckered structure 0.02 kcal/mol lower (30 real frequencies)
properties.evidence_log_original: pm7/s_pucker_opt.log (combined PM7 opt+freq, 0 imaginary frequencies) ; planar saddle check pm7/s_cs_freq.log ; GFN2-xTB xtb_xcheck/ohess_s/s_start.out

properties.state: phenylnitrene open-shell singlet 1A2 - the true lowest singlet, declared but NOT computed
properties.reason: Method-envelope / permitted-input-path limitation, not a statement about the molecule: an open-shell (unrestricted, Ms = 0) SCF is required for the 1A2 singlet, but (i) the permitted PM7 input path rejects the UHF route keyword that an unrestricted Ms=0 calculation needs, and (ii) GFN2-xTB exposes only --uhf = multiplicity-1, with no restricted-to-broken-symmetry option. The exploratory guess=mix run (pm7/s_bs_opt.log) is NOT independent evidence about broken-symmetry solutions: with multiplicity 1 and no UHF keyword, Gaussian PM7 is restricted by construction, so its collapse onto the closed-shell RHF energy is expected and proves nothing. No geometry, frequency or energy for 1A2 is therefore declared at this level; nothing from that log enters the declared properties.
properties.expected_character: open-shell 1A2 n-pi biradical singlet, planar, two unpaired electrons (N 2p + ring pi)
properties.evidence_log_original: pm7/s_bs_opt.log (exploratory attempt; a restricted calculation by construction - not evidence for or against a broken-symmetry solution)

edges.channel: interstate (electronic state change / intersystem crossing), no bond-order change
edges.note: Interstate (spin-surface) transition, not an activated elementary step: no first-order saddle exists on a single PES, so ts_opt/frequency/short_irc do not apply; the two endpoint states are delivered as species minima instead. No barrier is declared. The PM7 closed-shell 1A1 relative energy (+45.9 kcal/mol) is a semiempirical value for a state that is not the lowest singlet and is not a singlet-triplet gap; the GFN2-xTB restricted singlet lies below the triplet, i.e. the level dependence is unresolved.

edges.channel: interstate (electronic state change / intersystem crossing), no bond-order change
edges.note: Interstate (spin-surface) transition with no single-PES saddle (ts_opt/frequency/short_irc inapplicable); the target 1A2 open-shell singlet additionally cannot be computed through the permitted input path (UHF route keyword policy-blocked; xTB offers only --uhf = multiplicity-1). Edge marked accessible: false; no barrier and no gap are declared.
